channel.title: Cortexplor - AI News & Trends
channel.description: AI news, trends and numbers from Brazil and around the world.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.1, Cuts Cache Price 75%
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 scores higher on coding and research benchmarks, cuts cached-token pricing 75%, and adds zero data retention for enterprises.

item.title: Pentagon Rolls Out ChatGPT and Grok, Leaves Out Anthropic
item.description: The Pentagon expanded GenAI.mil with ChatGPT and Grok for 3 million workers, while Anthropic's Claude stays out after a legal dispute over military use.

item.title: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion in Taiwan's MediaTek
item.description: Nvidia invested $3.5 billion in MediaTek as part of an expanded AI chip partnership, giving it access to Nvidia's NVLink Fusion technology, reports say.

item.title: OpenAI's ChatGPT ad business hits $1 billion revenue
item.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT advertising business reached $1 billion in annualized revenue about 200 days after launch, as pressure builds ahead of an expected IPO.

item.title: OpenAI to Cut Cursor's Access to Its Models After SpaceX Deal
item.description: OpenAI will end model access for Cursor after SpaceX's acquisition of the coding startup, with a proposed shutoff date of November 12, 2026, OpenAI says.

item.title: Sony Music and Warner Chappell Sue Anthropic Over Song Lyrics
item.description: Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic, alleging the AI lab pirated tens of thousands of songs to help train its Claude AI models for profit.

item.title: OpenAI Starts Showing ChatGPT Ads to Users in India
item.description: OpenAI has started showing ads on ChatGPT's Free and Go tiers in India as part of a wider global ad rollout, according to reporting from CNBC and TechCrunch.

item.title: Anthropic Launches Standard for AI Agents to Control Hardware
item.description: Anthropic unveiled its new Model Hardware Standard, letting AI agents operate lab and factory machines directly, according to reporting from CNBC and Wired.

item.title: US judge strikes down Pentagon's blacklist of Anthropic
item.description: A US federal judge strikes down the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic as a supply-chain risk, ruling the designation was unconstitutional retaliation.

item.title: Nvidia forecasts 70% revenue growth for fiscal 2028
item.description: Nvidia forecasts 70% revenue growth for its next fiscal year, 2028, after reporting record quarterly revenue of $96.2 billion, according to Axios and CNBC.

item.title: OpenAI report ties Hugging Face hack to training rewards
item.description: OpenAI's new report on the Hugging Face hack traces the behavior back to how its agents were rewarded during training, months before the actual breach.

item.title: OpenAI's executive exodus leaves Brockman with more power
item.description: As executives keep leaving OpenAI, president Greg Brockman is consolidating control over product, infrastructure, and its consumer and enterprise arms.
